scope: All exact entries in PED Hunter weapons.json, including its mining-finder entries. Source identity coverage is not image coverage.

entropia_nexus.image_interface: GET /api/image/{entityType}/{entityId}; HTTP 204 means no approved image at that time. A derived endpoint is only a candidate until actually retrieved.
entropia_nexus.reuse_evidence: Website terms identify MindArk ownership and describe Nexus as a fair-use fan resource. Contributor permission is granted to Nexus, not generally to visitors. No visitor redistribution license was found. This is not a determination that all informational use is prohibited.
entropia_nexus.repository_license_note: The source-available repository license is not an artwork reuse grant. No Nexus software or repository artwork was incorporated.
entropia_nexus.retrieval_policy: One saved bulk identity response per entity type; no per-weapon page crawl. Only three bounded representative image requests were made; all returned 204. Remaining image availability is untested, not absent.

entropia_central.example_result: The exact Falcata page explicitly reports its image missing. Its generic ec_main.jpg social card is not weapon art.
entropia_central.reuse_evidence: Terms prohibit automated extraction without explicit written permission. Contributor rights are granted to Central, not generally to visitors. Do not crawl or bulk download this source under the current evidence.

entropia_life.example_result: The exact Falcata page links this image. Pixels and redistribution permission were not verified; it was not downloaded or bundled.
entropia_life.reuse_evidence: Legal terms expressly require owner permission for software cataloguing or distributing collected data; MindArk retains ownership of game media. No bulk Life retrieval was performed.

mindark.reuse_evidence: The notice reserves copyright and ungranted rights, allows informational personal/non-commercial website-content use, and does not establish a general license to redistribute third-party-hosted weapon art. No permission request was sent and no legal terms were accepted on the user's behalf.

entropia_museum_guide.reuse_evidence: Page 1 explicitly licenses content CC BY-SA 4.0. Page 8 describes reuse and permission for previously published material. The cropped image retains attribution, source, change notice and ShareAlike license; underlying game/trademark rights remain MindArk's.
entropia_museum_guide.example_result: Static pixel inspection: page 14 JPEG object 176 explicitly titles Sollomate Opalo and shows the complete unobscured weapon. One original 64x64 crop is bundled. Page 16 Bukin's Blade model is obscured by stat text/red annotations and is recorded unusable, not reconstructed.
entropia_museum_guide.retrieval_policy: Read licensed text first, then retrieve original PDF bytes once for extraction; no viewer, GUI or game operation. Owned CREATE_NO_WINDOW System.Drawing memory-only conversion exited normally.
entropia_museum_guide.historical_appearance_limit: The source depicts the exact named item in 2017; its current in-game appearance has not been directly inspected.

entropia_wiki.retrieval_result: Both HTTP and HTTPS About.aspx requests failed with ECONNREFUSED. No TLS bypass, environment change or bulk retry was attempted.

fallback.origin: Original PED Hunter neutral outlined question mark, generated locally; not a weapon silhouette or a claimed item image.
fallback.meaning: Exact usable artwork is unavailable, unreviewed, identity-ambiguous, rights-unresolved or broken. The saved setup label and active check remain authoritative.

coverage_limit: Every catalog entry is inventoried. One exact weapon image is bundled under the guide publisher's CC BY-SA 4.0 notice with attribution/provenance. One inspected image is unusable. Most source-image availability/reuse remains untested; no complete artwork-coverage claim is made. See the explicit per-entry inventory.
